questions.markdown:
Analyze how expression evaluation changes if parentheses are added to the following line:

`result = 10 + 2 * 5 / 2 - 3;`

Discuss the above result before and after applying parentheses.
Explain the shortcut assignment operator in C expressions, with an appropriate example.

Write a C program using a switch statement to check whether an entered alphabet is a vowel or a consonant.
Analyze how using a switch simplifies the logic compared to multiple if-else conditions.
Experiment with break and continue statements in terms of loop control and execution flow with an example.

A library stores sorted book IDs. The librarian wants to search for a particular book ID quickly.
Build a C program to search for a book ID using the appropriate searching technique. Also, justify why the corresponding searching technique is chosen to be appropriate over others.

A teacher maintains the marks of students in two different tests as two matrices of size $3\times 3$.
She wants to calculate the total marks for each student by adding the corresponding elements of the two matrices.

i) Develop a C program to add two $3\times 3$ matrices and display the resulting matrix.
ii) Explain clearly how each element of the matrices is accessed and summed using nested loops.

Develop a function named "difference" that takes two integers as input parameters and returns their absolute difference as an integer using C programming. Declare the function prototype and mention the formal parameters

A student writes a function `void increment (int a, int b)` to increase both variables by 10 and but finds the original values unchanged when he prints them in main. Analyze the error and write the c program by rewriting the function and print the updated value in main (Hint: use pointers).

questions.markdown:
Design a C program to analyze student performance using nested function calls.
Your program should:

i) Accept marks of N students in M subjects and store them in a 2D array.
ii) Compute each student's average using the function `studentAverage()`.
iii) Call the function `subjectAverage()` inside `studentAverage()` to compute the average marks for each subject (demonstrating function nesting).
iv) Display both student-wise and subject-wise averages clearly.
Develop a C program that uses a structure to store the dimensions of a rectangle (length and width) and calculate and display its area and perimeter.
Write a C program to define a structure to store census data (city name, population, literacy level), read data for 5 cities and display the city with the highest literacy level.
Develop a C program to copy one string to another using pointers only. (without using library functions for strings)
Classify 4 cybercrimes where computers are used as a tool to commit crimes and explain 2 examples of such crimes.
